newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tajik rebel group breaks through from Afghanstan.
newsitem.headline: Tajik rebel group breaks through from Afghanstan.

text.p: A group of Tajik opposition guerrillas has broken through Tajikistan's southern border from Afghanistan, a border guards' spokesman said on Saturday.
The spokesman said he could not confirm reports by two Russian news agencies that one of the Russian-led border guards which patrol the uneasy frontier had been killed.

The incident did not appear to be linked with fighting in Afghanistan, but Itar-Tass news agency said the guards had been put on a state of alert because of tensions across the border, where Taleban Islamic fighters captured the capital Kabul on Friday.

The agencies said that a group of more than 250 rebels had been trying to break through the border near the Tajik town of Kalaikhum for days. An unknown number succeeded at dusk on Friday, holding up three buses and a border guards' car.
RIA news agency quoted a source in the Tajik security ministry as saying that a guard was killed in the crossfire.
The Tajik rebels are loyal to Islamic opposition leaders driven into exile in Afghanistan and Iran after losing a clan-based civil war which broke out soon after independence from the Soviet Union.

A ceasefire signed in September 1994 was reconfirmed in July but both sides continue to accuse each other of violations in a struggle for control of strategic neck linking eastern and western Tajikistan.

Lieutenant-General Pavel Tarasenko, the head of the Russian border guards force in Tajikistan, the poorest of the former Soviet republics, flew on Saturday morning to the border area, where fighting was reported to be continuing.
On the way he told Itar-Tass news agency that the rebels may have been trying to reinforce guerrillas in the central region.
The border guards' spokesman said there had been about 30 attempts to break through since beginning of year, 20 of which resulted in armed clashes.

The latest breakthough attempt was two weeks ago. "This particular place is especially tough for the border guards," he said, adding that three had been killed and 13 wounded in clashes on border so far this year.
